company.name: Fulcrum
company.shortDescription: Fulcrum is a SaaS platform allowing manufacturers to improve efficiency through workflow optimization and automated data collection.
company.description: Fulcrum is a SaaS manufacturing platform designed and built from scratch to bring modern and futuristic concepts to small and mid-sized production shops. The product is a strong vote in favor of decentralized manufacturing, juicing up the system through connectivity and automation. Their long term mission is to create a connected manufacturing supply chain, reducing tedious data entry, and increasing the speed and efficiency of the entire network supported by the most kickass system available.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $18,000,000, or 45.11% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $17,937,918 to $179,168,432, a 9.99x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 55 (-34 over 90 days) and market heat at 62 (-3).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
